description: This file defines a React component 'VirtualizedTree' for rendering a virtualized, expandable tree view with lazy loading of child nodes, including handling of selection, expansion, and keyboard navigation.

classes.name: VirtualizedTreeHandle
classes.description: Type for the handle object exposing methods to control the tree component.

classes.name: TreeNode
classes.description: Type representing a node in the tree, with properties like id, parentId, depth, hasChildren, data, and expanded state.

methods.name: VirtualizedTree
methods.description: Main React component implementing a virtualized, lazy-loading tree view with expand/collapse and selection features.
